scope: Theorem 5.1 (Degree-one CM extraction) of the manuscript “The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties” (preprints/The-rational-Hodge-conjecture-for-CM-abelian-varieties-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e3e66a407773ad5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let v : GE → {1, −1} be odd with v(1) = 1, and use the multiplicity-line theta construction prescribed by d(τ) = v(τ−1). Given a finite collection of its finite adelic Schwartz inputs, there is a common sufficiently deep principal ball quotient S0 = Γ\D on which every associated theta one-form class belongs to spanC n f U(v)1  : f ∈ HomHdg U(v), H1 (S0, Q) o . (5.1) The maps in this formula are rational Hodge maps, and their images are viewed after extension to C. The conclusion persists after passage to a deeper principal level.
